name: personal identification code
issuer: the Estonian population register (the sheet names no office)
note: Estonia's sheet (its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back)), read 2026-10-30: the individual's TIN is the personal identification code, 11 digits GYYMMDDSSSC: sex and century, the birth date, a serial for those born the same day and a checksum (its rule isn't given here, `check` left out); individuals get it automatically. The sheet points to the law (riigiteataja.ee/akt/106032012004, not read) for the issuing body, so the issuer is written without its office. Read as given at birth, to residents. No fee or time is stated.

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, Estonia: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
sources.said: Information about issuance of TIN for individuals (personal identification code, see structure in section II below) and about TIN issuing bodies can be found in Estonian here: https://www.riigiteataja.ee/akt/106032012004 ... An Estonian personal identification code consists of 11 digits ... The form is GYYMMDDSSSC, where G shows sex and century of birth
